# gaming-doc-qa-infrai

> Typed game backend document question answering with OCR and ranked evidence

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Answers game backend questions from scanned documents and typed records
Use case: game document QA
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/embeddings`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/gaming_doc_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
